label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.4…: In Aquinas' q.3 a.4 first proof, the essential…
locator: I q.3 a.4 co., first proof: impossibile est autem quod esse sit causatum tantum ex principiis essentialibus rei ... nulla res sufficit quod sit sibi causa essendi, si habeat esse causatum
interpretation: The claim denies the sufficiency of essential principles as an efficient cause of the subject's own caused esse. It does not deny essential/analytic/noncausal reasons for necessary truths or entail that esse distinct from essence is impossible without an external cause independently of the other fork of the argument.
